text.en:
Restores Health on reload based on the amount of hits before reload.
Health gain per hit varies between Weapon Types.

Ranges between 20 HP to 80 HP for a full magazine.
text.zh-chs:
根据填装之前完成的命中数恢复生命值。
每次命中可恢复的生命值和武器类型相关。

可恢复生命值为 20 至 80 点。

text.en:
Finishing a Reload restores health based on the number of hits scored with the weapon before reloading.

Scoring 100% of the Magazine as hits restores 50 HP.

Glaive Melee hits don't count. Grenade Launcher hits each count as 50% of the Magazine.
